content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, knee-length cut, charcoal gray #36454F, structured woven fabric. Silk blouse, classic collar, hip-length hem, crisp white #FFFFFF, smooth matte fabric. Wool-crepe wide-leg trousers, straight leg, ankle length, deep forest green #228B22, soft drapey texture. Leather loafers, almond toe, low block heel, tan brown #D2691E, smooth polished leather. Gold geometric link necklace, medium scale, brushed metal finish. Pearl stud earrings, classic round shape, lustrous white nacre. Structured tote bag, rectangular silhouette, neutral beige #F5F5DC, durable coated canvas with leather trim. This outfit embodies the \"smart\" dress code perfect for an autumn office day, balancing professional polish with seasonal warmth through the wool blazer and trousers. The charcoal and forest green palette feels grounded and sophisticated without being overly severe, while the crisp white silk blouse adds a necessary breath of freshness to the layered look. Completing the ensemble with comfortable loafers and subtle gold jewelry ensures you can navigate long meetings and walk confidently throughout the workspace."}
